title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - Priya Shah & Daniel Rivera (API / Console / Dedicated / Private)
body:
Goal for this 1:1: align on near-term priorities across Hosted API, Console rollouts, Dedicated capacity scheduling, and Private deployment milestones; agree on risks and clear owners for action items.

Quick status (what I have prepared):
- Hosted API: customer regen rate issues seem reduced after batch tuning; still seeing a few p95 latency spikes for 8k+ seq. Need engineering diagnosis on KV cache warmup.
- Console: UX pass for rollout rules is queued; product wants canary build next week for beta customers. Need ETA on backend feature flags and tracing hooks.
- Dedicated: sales needs capacity reservation timeline for Q2 customers (2x RTX A100 pools). Clarify scaling/planning for reserved GPU pools + autoscale behaviour.
- Private: compliance checklist (KMS/HSM integration) in review; ask eng lead about support window for first on-prem rollout.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick wins & blockers (5m) - where do you need product help?
2) Hosted API perf follow-up (8m) - KV cache warmup hypothesis, repro steps, perf dashboard links
3) Console rollout readiness (7m) - feature flags, telemetry, canary plan + success metrics
4) Dedicated capacity timeline & costs (6m) - reservation lead times, infra constraints
5) Private deployment support & next steps (4m) - checklist gaps and on-prem install window

Open questions I want answered:
- Can we reproduce the p95 latency spike locally with a controlled prefix cache warmup test? If not, what additional tracing do we need on the runtime?
- For console canary, can we have a backend toggle that scopes rollouts by org-id by next Tue? If not, what's the blocker?
- Dedicated: what's the minimum commit we can promise to sales (in terms of GPUs and SLOs) while keeping ops overhead reasonable?
- Private: can SRE own the initial on-prem deploy runbook or should we engage professional services?

Action items to propose in meeting (I will volunteer or assign):
- Engineering: add a short KV cache warmup test to the perf harness and run against the p95 repro trace (owner: Daniel, due: 2026-03-11)
- Eng + Product: finalize console canary plan doc with success metrics and rollback criteria; share with beta customers (owner: Priya + Daniel, due: 2026-03-09)
- Platform: provide Dedicated capacity lead time + cost estimate for 2x A100 pools and a recommended autoscale policy (owner: Avery, due: 2026-03-10)
- PM/Sales/Solutions: draft Private deployment support SLA and engagement model for first customer (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-12)

Notes / talking points (to mention):
- Remind Daniel we need retention of per-route token costing surfaced in Console for dedicated customers (helps sales commitments).
- Emphasize graceful degradation plan: fallback model variant + regional failover should be tested during Dedicated capacity load tests.
- Ask about telemetry: do we have tracing hooks emitted for every fallback decision? If not, add to backlog.

Follow-up cadence: propose a short sync next week after eng runs the KV cache test (15m).

Misc scratchpad / TODOs (for later):
- Ping infra for dedicated capacity quotas and verify availability in us-west-2.
- Drop a note to beta customers about canary timeline once backend toggle confirmed.
- Draft one-pager for sales on Dedicated commit guarantees.

Comments to self: be explicit about trade-offs between latency SLO and batching/cost. If eng proposes aggressive batching to reduce cost, ask for impact on tail latency and canary acceptance criteria.

End of notes.
